Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description

As a Software Engineer Intern at FormFactor, you will gain hands-on experience in a high-tech manufacturing environment and learn about the processes that power today’s electronics. The internship will support software tools and automation used in semiconductor device testing. This role is ideal for an undergraduate student who has completed introductory coursework in C/C++, object-oriented programming, and basic software development practices. This is a great opportunity to apply what you’ve learned in school and gain real-world skills by working closely with experienced engineers.

What You’ll Do



- Develop and maintain software modules that interface with semiconductor test equipment, measurement instruments and internal test frameworks.
- Implement C/C++ components that support test automation, data parsing, and device characterization workflows.
- Apply OOP principles to build modular, reusable components for test automations and analytic tools.
- Assist in debugging issues across software, scripts, and databases.
- Contribute to tools that help engineers design probe cards, automate production drawing and data file generation.
- Participate in code reviews and collaborate with test, validation, and product engineering teams.
- Follow established development workflows, version control practices, and documentation standards, so the team can work efficiently and accurately.
- Collaborate with engineers and technicians in areas like equipment, facilities and production to solve problems and improve results.

Preferred Qualifications



- Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Coursework or project experience in C/C++.
- Understanding of object-oriented programming concepts.
- Familiarity with basic data structures, algorithms, debugging fundamentals and the ability to reason about performance and memory usage
- Basic understanding of electronics fundamentals, including voltage, current, digital logic, timing etc.
- Interest in semiconductor devices, electronics, or hardware-software interaction.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially when troubleshooting issues that span software and scripts.
- Ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers across software, test, and validation teams.
- Clear communication skills for documenting code, reporting issues, and discussing test results.

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Communication, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Problem Solving, Software Debugging, Working Independently

Education & Experience

Minimum of 1 - 2 years of related experience. Operative/Technician roles will typically operate more complex machinery/processes | Required

Pay Range

$22.10 - $29.03

Pay Range Explained

This role in Livermore, California pays between $22.10 and $29.03 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. These protections apply to all aspects of employment, including but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotions, and compensation.

For roles that are designated as remote-eligible, employees cannot be located in: AL, AK, AR, DE, GA, HI, IL, IA, LA, ME, MD, MS, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NM, ND, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, WV, WI, WY. This list is continuously evolving and being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. A role is remote-eligible only when it is listed as "Remote" in the job location.

About CMHC

At CMHC, the work you do and the work we do together matters. We come to work every day with a common purpose: to realize a future where everyone in Canada has a home that they can afford and meets their needs.

Our people are second to none. We lean in with courage, band together as a community and try new things to make a lasting impact on housing from coast to coast to coast.

Join us and be part of a team that's committed to making a real difference and be part of something meaningful.

What’s in it for you

We’ve Got The Purpose And Perks You Need For An Exciting Internship Experience. Here’s What You Can Expect By Joining Us



-  A 4-month internship with hands-on learning experiences. 
-  Accrued vacation days (up to 5 days per 4-month internship). 
-  Support in your personal and professional growth with training and mentorship – because when you thrive, we thrive. 
-  An inclusive workplace culture and environment with Employee Resource Groups such as our Young Professional’s Network that will allow you to meet, connect, and build a community and sense of belonging with other students.  

About The Role

We are hiring 4 full-time Summer intern to join CMHC beginning in May through August 2027. Our internship program is designed to help you grow, with access to training resources, interesting projects, and networking sessions that support your development and help you discover your full potential.

What You'll Do



-  Contribute to the entire software development lifecycle, from design to deployment. 
-  Collaborate with experienced software developers to learn, understand existing software solutions and deliver value to our clients and employees. 
-  Assist in the analysis and troubleshooting of software issues. 
-  Contribute to the documentation of code and development processes. 
-  Work with cross-functional agile teams. 

What You Should Have



-  Currently enrolled in or a recent graduate of a College or University degree in a related discipline such as computer science, computer engineering, or related field. 
-  A previous experience and knowledge of programming languages. The experience can be acquired through the studies, work experience or volunteer activities. 
-  Strong critical thinking skills and attention to detail. 
-  Strong oral and written communication, excellent organizational and planning skills and the ability to work independently as well as within a team setting. 

It Would Be Great If You Also Had 



-  Bilingualism (English and French) is an asset, but not required. 
-  Experience working with the following technologies:

-  .NET Full Stack Development, NodeJS, TypeScript, C#, ASP.Net MVC, .Net Core, Web API, Visual Studio, PowerBi. 
-  Front end development using HTML, CSS and JavaScript frameworks such as ReactJS and NodeJS 
-  Application Development areas: Microsoft Dynamics CRM, , Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, SAP SuccessFactors Custom applications built with microservices, Application interfaces and integration. 
-  Test Automation frameworks for Unit and integration testing like XUnit, Jest, NUnit, PostmanSource code management Git and DevOps with Azure DevOps 
-  CI/CD Pipelines with Azure YAML Pipeline. 
-  Azure cloud platform, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions 
Posting closing date: Note, the competition will remain active until filled.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion 

We’re committed to employment equity and encourage women, Indigenous Peoples, persons with disabilities, veterans and persons of all races, ethnicities, religions, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities and expressions to apply. We also welcome applications from non-Canadians who are eligible to work in Canada.

CMHC is an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought – and of people – are recognized, valued, and considered essential to achieving our mission.

About

 Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion 

What happens after you apply 

We know that applying for a new job can be both exciting and daunting, and we appreciate your effort.  Learn more about our hiring process . If you are selected for an interview or testing, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

If you applied before and you were not successful don’t worry – we're always posting new positions, so don’t hesitate to give it another shot. We’re excited to see what you bring to the table this time around!

Dayforce, a global leader in Human Capital Management (HCM) with headquarters in Toronto, Ontario, and Minneapolis, Minnesota, operates across North America, EMEA, and APJ regions. Our Cloud HCM platform, recognized for its unified database and continuous calculation engine, enhances efficiency, productivity, and compliance for global workforces. We are committed to "Making Work Life Better™" for employees, customers, and partners worldwide.

As an Intern at Dayforce, you’ll gain real-world experience with meaningful responsibilities, access to development programs, and the chance to collaborate globally, bringing new ideas and optimizing processes across multiple business units.

Job Title: Software Developer Intern

Location: Virtual

Duration: Winter 2027 - 8 Months (January 2027 - August 2027)

Availability: *Full-time availability of 37.5 - 40 hours weekly is required to be eligible for this opportunity.

Benefits For Students



- Experience working for one of the fastest growing Human Capital Management technology companies in the world and access to Dayforce’s development programs and resources
- Ability to work with and build relationships with team members across the globe
- Autonomy to bring forth new ideas and optimize existing structures within the organization
- Meaningful responsibilities, enabling you to obtain real-world experience
- Dynamic hands-on exposure to multiple business units and stakeholders across Dayforce
- Opportunities to work across different technology stacks using modern tools, frameworks, and libraries

About The Opportunity

As a Software Developer Intern at Dayforce, you will join one of our software development teams and contribute to the development of enterprise-scale cloud software used by customers around the world.

Working alongside experienced Software Developers, Test Engineers, Product Managers, UX Designers, and other partners, you will gain hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, code review, troubleshooting, and delivery. Depending on your team placement, you may contribute to areas such as frontend and backend development, APIs and services, test automation, cloud and data platforms, developer tooling, or AI-enabled solutions.

You will receive mentorship and support from experienced team members while being encouraged to ask questions, contribute ideas, learn new technologies, and progressively take ownership of your work. This is an opportunity to strengthen your technical skills while solving real product and customer problems in a collaborative, agile environment.

What You’ll Get To Do



- Design, develop, test, and maintain software features and solutions with support from experienced engineers.
- Write clean, readable, maintainable, and well-tested code using modern software development practices.
- Work cross-functionally with Software Developers, Test Engineers, Product Managers, UX Designers, and other partners to deliver high-quality product experiences.
- Contribute to new product capabilities as well as enhancements and maintenance of existing functionality.
- Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery.
- Investigate software defects and technical issues, contribute to root-cause analysis, and help drive issues to resolution.
- Develop and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and other forms of test automation.
- Work with technologies such as APIs, databases, cloud services, web applications, and development tools based on your team assignment.
- Participate in technical, design, and architectural discussions and learn how engineering teams evaluate technical choices and tradeoffs.
- Contribute to code quality, engineering practices, tooling, automation, and development process improvements.
- Help ensure software can be reliably built, tested, and delivered through modern development and deployment pipelines.
- Explore emerging technologies, including AI-powered development tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solve technical problems.
- Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and approaches while taking increasing ownership of development tasks.

Skills And Experience We Value



- Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Programming experience gained through coursework, personal projects, internships, hackathons, open-source contributions, or other hands-on experience.
- Familiarity with one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Understanding of programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and problem-solving concepts.
- Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
- Familiarity with software development fundamentals such as debugging, testing, and version control.
- Interest in learning modern software development technologies and practices, including web applications, APIs, cloud technologies, data platforms, automation, or AI.
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with curiosity and a willingness to learn.
- Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within an agile development team.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- A strong sense of ownership and enthusiasm for building high-quality software.

What Would Really Make You Stand Out

Experience with any of the following is an asset, but is not required:



- C#/.NET, Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
- Modern frontend technologies and frameworks such as React, HTML, and CSS.
- REST APIs, JSON, backend services, or microservices.
- Relational or NoSQL databases and data processing technologies.
- Cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
- Automated testing, unit-testing frameworks, or test automation tools.
- Git and collaborative source control practices.
- CI/CD concepts and DevOps tools and practices.
- Docker, Kubernetes, containers, or distributed systems concepts.
- Data and analytics technologies such as Databricks, Apache Spark, or data lake platforms.
- AI-powered development tools, AI applications, LLM APIs, agents, or related automation.
- Applying software design patterns and writing maintainable, testable code.
- SaaS or enterprise software development through previous internships, academic projects, personal projects, hackathons, or open-source contributions.

What You’ll Gain



- Hands-on experience contributing to production software in a global SaaS organization.
- Mentorship from experienced software engineers and technical leaders.
- Exposure to modern engineering practices, architecture, cloud technologies, testing, data platforms, AI, and DevOps depending on your team placement.
- Experience collaborating across Engineering, Product, UX, Quality, Data, and other partner teams.
- Opportunities to take increasing ownership as your skills and confidence grow.
- Practical experience solving real customer, product, and engineering problems.

We understand that no matter where you are, choosing a new employer is always one of life’s most stressful events. We encourage you to check us out at Dayforce.com or follow us on LinkedIn to learn more about how we are impacting the world of work for our customers, employees and you!

Fraudulent Recruiting

Beware of fraudulent recruiting. Legitimate Dayforce contacts will use an @dayforce.com or @Ceridian.com email address. We do not request money, checks, equipment orders, or sensitive personal data during the recruitment process. If you have been asked for any of the above, or believe you have been contacted by someone posing as a Dayforce employee, please refer to our fraudulent recruiting statement found here: https://www.dayforce.com/be-aware-of-recruiting-fraud

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

 At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

 Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

 ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

 What We Do 

 Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

 AI PROGRAMMER INTERN

 What You'll Do 

 The Epic Games UE Al team is looking for a Research Engineering Intern who is excited about machine learning and artificial intelligence. Epic Games creates and deploys advanced computer vision, computer graphics and machine learning technologies to transform the production and consumption of digital media. This includes physics-based simulation, ML-based character animation, neural and inverse rendering, and automated generative animation techniques, among others. At Epic we research, develop and deploy these technologies for Unreal Engine and other Epic products.

 In this role, you will 

• Assist with prototyping machine learning and generative approaches for game content creation as part of a defined project with guidance from a mentor 

• Support experiments by preparing data, running tests, collecting results, and helping document observations 

• Assist with implementing and testing research concepts using Python and relevant machine learning tools 

• Read and discuss research papers with team members to develop familiarity with current approaches and techniques 

• Work with your mentor and immediate team to support ongoing research and development projects 

• Communicate progress, ask questions, and incorporate feedback while working through assigned tasks 

• Share your work and key learnings through regular updates and a final presentation to the team 
 
 What we're looking for 

• Currently enrolled in an undergraduate (Bachelor's) or Master's degree program in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline 

• Foundational programming skills in Python, with C++ experience considered a plus 

• Introductory experience with a machine learning framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow through coursework, academic projects, or personal projects 

• Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and an interest in exploring their practical applications 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eagerness to learn new tools, techniques, and technologies 

• Knowledge of, or strong interest in, one or more of the following areas: real-time graphics, computer vision, machine learning, animation, large language models, speech recognition, speech synthesis, linguistics, performance capture, or 3D reconstruction 

• Exposure to academic research, relevant coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions in machine learning, computer vision, computer graphics, or related technical areas 

• Familiarity with Unreal Engine or another game engine is a plus 

• Interest in games, digital humans, or real-time content creation 

• Ability to communicate progress, ask questions, collaborate with others, and incorporate feedback 
 
 This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers . This is going to be Epic! 
 ABOUT US

 Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

 Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic! 

 Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

 Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience. 
 
 We began as an original. We remain an Original at the top of the convenience industry. Our company invented the concept of convenience retailing. But we didn’t stop there. 7-Eleven® has captured the world with a proven willingness and ability to innovate. We were the first company in America to offer fresh-brewed to-go coffee. More than six million of our Slurpee® beverages have been sipped since 1966. And, to continuously stay ahead of the curve, we introduce more than 2,500+ new products each year.
 
With over 86,000 global locations, 7-Eleven Inc. is the world’s largest operator, franchiser and licensor of convenience stores and is also one of the nation’s largest independent gasoline retailers. The company continues to achieve operational accolades, win awards in franchising and drive innovation in retail in the mission to make life a little easier for our guests by being where they need us, when they need us.

 Launch your career with real-world impact. Our Internship Program gives you the opportunity to build deep experience in a specific functional area while contributing to a meaningful business project. Build your professional network, learn directly from senior leaders, and gain a behind-the-scenes view of how the business works - bringing our strategy to life. With guidance from a dedicated coach and opportunities to connect across the organization, you will build valuable relationships, broaden your business perspective, and finish the summer by showcasing your work to functional leaders.
  
 The paid internship takes place during Summer 2027. You will gain practical experience, grow your professional network, develop in-demand skills, and help shape the future of merchandising at the world’s largest convenience retailer.

 At 7-Eleven, data powers everything from store operations and merchandising to customer engagement, supply chain optimization, artificial intelligence, and enterprise decision-making.

 As a Data Engineer Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers and architects to build scalable data products, cloud-native data pipelines, and modern data platforms that support thousands of stores and millions of customer interactions. This role provides hands-on experience with enterprise-scale data engineering, Databricks, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled development practices.

 Responsibilities 
 
• Design, develop, and support scalable data pipelines and data integration solutions. 
• Build data engineering solutions using Python, SQL, PySpark, and modern cloud technologies. 
• Develop and maintain trusted data products that enable analytics, reporting, operational intelligence, and AI use cases. 
• Contribute to enterprise data platforms built on Databricks, Apache Spark, and Lakehouse architectures. 
• Implement data quality, monitoring, testing, and observability capabilities to improve data reliability. 
• Participate in AI-assisted software development using enterprise-approved AI tools. 
• Collaborate with Data Engineers, Architects, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions. 
• Apply software engineering best practices including source control, code reviews, CI/CD, and automated testing. 
• Improve data processing performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
• Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, stand-ups, design reviews, and retrospectives. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field. 
• Experience with Python, Java, Scala, or another modern programming language. 
• Foundational knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data structures. 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills. 
• Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and thrive in a team-oriented environment. Preferred Qualifications 
 
• Hands-on experience through coursework, internships, research, personal projects, or open-source contributions. 
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform. 
• Exposure to Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, or related technologies. 
• Experience using Git and modern software development tools. 
• Understanding of Agile development methodologies and CI/CD practices. 
• Interest in Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Analytics Engineering.
